description_expanded: Overview5.0(6 reviews)INLET BEACH – Stepping Stone Luxurious Coastal Retreat | Steps from Rosemary Beach | Sleeps 12 DESCRIPTION Welcome to “Stepping Stone Home”, your ideal beach escape in Inlet Beach. Perfectly positioned just steps from 30A and Rosemary Beach, this stunning coastal retreat offers ample space, luxurious design, and flexibility for your entire group. Recently renovated with $450k in upgrades and improvements, including a brand-new private elevator, this property combines comfort, style, and convenience for a memorable beach vacation. OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS Unwind in your own private oasis—featuring a serene pool and sun-drenched courtyard perfect for lounging, grilling, and dining al fresco with friends and family. Your stay includes beach chairs, umbrellas, and four adult bikes, making it easy to explore the shoreline and nearby attractions. Whether you're soaking up the sun or cruising the coast, everything you need for a relaxing getaway is right here. HOME FEATURES 4 bedrooms | 4 full + 1 half bathrooms | Sleeps 12 Three king suites with private en-suites Bunk room with twin-over-twin bunks and pull-out trundles (sleeps 6) Two primary suites, each with soaking tubs, showers, views, and peaceful retreat space Two outdoor courtyards and a private pool (heated for an additional fee) Open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area with high-end appliances Refreshment station with coffee maker and mini fridge on the top floor New XBox Series X with two controllers New extra-large Samsung Smart TVs Hi-speed WiFi internet New beach chairs, bikes, and umbrellas New AC/heat systems Whole-house 6-stage water purification systemShow less
